result.summary: Found a critical visual breakage in the bottom navigation: a thick black bar obscures the icons and the tab bar is clipped at the screen edge, blocking navigation.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar is visually broken: a thick black horizontal bar cuts across the middle of the bar obscuring the Search and Saved icons, and all tab icons are clipped off at the bottom edge of the viewport
issues.suggestion: Fix bottom safe-area handling so the system gesture indicator does not overlap app navigation; add proper bottom padding and ensure the tab bar with full icons and labels is fully visible above the system bar

issues.description: Bottom tab labels and parts of icons are missing/not legible - only a green Home icon, partially obscured Search and Bookmark icons, and Profile icon are faintly visible with no text labels
issues.suggestion: Restore the complete bottom tab bar with fully rendered icons and text labels, ensuring correct size, spacing, and contrast against the background
